title: Page 9
lines: 事实上这三天她也很害怕，因为小姐的表现太镇定了，有苦却不肯诉，又有赵修缘步步进逼，她真的很怕小姐会逼疯自己。
主仆俩哭了小半晌，汪袭绿的心情渐渐平静下来，这才看着半屏，哽咽地说道：“半屏，打小你就一直跟着我，你最知道我了，其实我当初决定断情远走，并不是不爱他，而是怕会像我娘一样，明明是正室，却要活得那样卑微委屈，我不要过那种日子，我宁愿守着对他的爱过日子，也不要守着一个不爱我的男人。”
“奴婢知道……小姐心里的苦，奴婢最知道。”半屏抹着泪说道，要不是知道主子的心中有多苦，她又怎会那么厌恶褚靖南呢？
“他若真是死了，宝儿以后就真的是没爹的孩子了，我该怎么跟宝儿说呢？”
当初远走怀孕生子，她其实也没决定就此不让父子俩相认，只不过宝儿年纪还小，需要她的照顾，所以她才会不让褚家知道他的存在，免得母子分离，但等他大些后，终究还是要让他认祖归宗的。
本以为他们父子俩总有相见的一天，可如今若是褚靖南真的死了，那父子相见无期，只怕便是将来九泉之下相逢，也不能相识了。
一想到这里，汪袭绿就觉得自己对不起褚靖南，一颗心也更加惶惶不安。
“小姐，不会的，将军会没事的，你以前不总说将军大智大勇，这么聪明的人又怎么做没有把握的事呢？将军一定会回来的。”
“是这样吗？”听着半屏的笃定的话语，汪袭绿就像溺水的人好不容易抓住一根浮木似的，很认真的想要相信。
“回来自然是要回来的，可是你可不可以先跟我解释一下宝儿是谁？”
凭空冒出来的声音让汪袭绿愕然抬头，却没有看见半个人影，但方才那一声却熟悉得让她心慌，也让她惊喜。
是他吗？会是他吗？
“是谁？”汪袭绿屏着气地低声喝问，还漾着水雾的眸子隐隐迸出一抹希冀来。
当她终于见到那朝思暮想的身影自大帐篷中隔出来的小书房闪身而出。
虽然此刻的他一点也没有平素的傲然潇洒，看起来就像个不修边幅的老兵，可汪袭绿还是一眼就认出了他来，她抬手捂唇，却始终没有出声，就怕为他招来了祸患。
他没死，真的没死！
“你是不是该先解释一下，宝儿究竟是谁？”
褚靖南本不该在此时见她，因为今晚便是他整个计划最重要的关键，之所以乔装改扮混进营里，原只是想来找爷爷商讨一下晚上的计划，里应外合，一举擒住所有混在营中的奸细。
但议完了事，又忍不住想悄悄地瞧她一眼，却没想到听到她嚎啕大哭，他就更迈不开脚步。
直到她和半屏提起了宝儿这个名字，和那串对话，他才终于忍不住地出声，心中除了满满的心疼之外，还有抑制不住的心疼。
“你……”没有回答他的问题，汪袭绿蓦地起身，眼前突然一黑，脑袋有些发晕，可她还是跌跌撞撞地朝他走去。
她必须确定他是真的，不是她悲伤至极所想出来的幻影。
但她才走了两步，身子便失去力气，眼看着就要摔跌在地，幸好褚靖南眼明手快，一个箭步上前扶住了她，并一把将她揽进怀里。
而刚刚抢上前来想要扶住自家主子的半屏则是顿住了脚步，然后毫不犹豫地回身往外走去，她要替他们守着这难得的两人空间。
当他的温热透过她那白晰的肌肤渗入她的身躯之中时，汪袭绿所有的恐惧、悲伤，还有以往对他的怨慰就全数消失。
原来，只要他活着……就什么都好，其他的都不重要了。
头一回，她主动环住了他的腰，踮脚仰首，热情的吻上他的唇，辗转流连。
褚靖南的心情登时激动不已，钢铁般的心顿时软绵。
她原谅他了吗？她怎么能这样的善良……竟然这样便原谅了他，他本已经准备了要用一辈子向她赎罪的。
一吻方休，瞧着汪袭绿那喘不过气来的模样，褚靖南轻抿的唇忍不住地往上勾了勾，要不是怕她又昏了过去，他怎么舍得放开她？
“究竟谁是宝儿？”为了怕自己克制不住，不合时宜地将她放倒，拆吃入腹，他只好重新提问，分散注意力。
“宝儿、宝儿是……”酡红着一张脸，汪袭绿的话到了唇边，却又止住。
当初她离开褚家时，连她自己都不知道自己有了身孕，现在她猛地说宝儿是他儿子，他会相信吗？
没有漏看她眸中一闪而过的害怕和犹豫，褚靖南知道她还是不敢完全对他放心，心中自是黯然，可是却也没有多说什么。“不想说便罢了，等你想说时再说吧。”
他轻拥着她，舍不得她为难犹豫，他为了她，放下了大男人的身段，化身一汪春水，将她从头到脚包裹得暖融融的。
她忽然抬头，认真地瞧着他脸上的浅笑，自然也看出了他眸底蕴藏着的黯然，她把玩着胸前的一颗盘扣，然后小小声地说道：“宝儿是你的儿子，今年已经一岁多了，可爱缠着人了……”
为了掩饰自己的紧张，汪袭绿叨叨絮絮地说着，她都说了好半晌了，可是褚靖南却完全没有任何的反应，让她忍不住地又抬起头瞧了他一眼，不瞧还好，这一瞧，就看到他震惊的呆楞模样。
他这是吓傻了吗？还是他不相信宝儿是他的儿子？
就在汪袭绿胡思乱想之际，褚靖南突然低头在她耳际低吼道：“你这个该死的女人，要不是现在情况不许可，我一定要揍你一顿屁股，你……”
果然，听她亲口说出来，他当真忍不住怒气啊……
原来，他相信呢，只是生气了。
汪袭绿的唇角再次微扬，然后很识相的又踮起脚，送上自己的红唇，只求能让暴怒中的褚靖南消消气。
两人之间再也没有秘密，更没有了隔阂，而那吻也从一开始发泄似的略微粗暴，转为柔情辗转，褚靖南的手甚至挑开了汪袭绿衣襟上的盘扣。
一颗、两颗、三颗……
“喂，天都快要黑了，你究竟出来不出来？”
就知道这厮一定是趁机占了绿丫头的便宜，要不然怎么会看一眼就看了一个时辰？虽然江成玉也很想宽宏大量的多给褚靖南一些时间，可是正事不能耽搁，于是他也只能在半屏那不赞同的目光中闯了进来，做那棒打鸳鸯的坏人了。
听到他的声音，汪袭绿像是被惊着似的，羞得连忙挣扎着想要退出褚靖南的怀抱，可褚靖南才不理会，正大光明地抱着汪袭绿，然后挑衅似地看着江成玉，颇为不满的说道：“真是没眼力，你不知道你现在做的是缺德事吗？”
听到这指责，江成玉简直就是欲哭无泪了，明明是这个大将军摆着正事不做，贪恋软玉温香，他好意提醒，却成了里外不是人的那个了。
“别这样说表哥，办正事要紧，我等你回来一起去找儿子。”脸上挂着一抹诱人的羞红，汪袭绿伸手替褚靖南整了整衣衫，然后推了推褚靖南，让他别误了正事。
“等我，这事完了后，咱们一起去接儿子！”褚镇南放肆地在她颊上吻了下，许下了承诺。
“失火啦！失火啦——”
因为他的一句等我，汪袭绿便安然的等着他，谁知等着等着，就等到了外头那嘈杂的嚷嚷。
content_en:
In fact, she was also very scared in the past three days, because the young lady acted too calmly and refused to complain about her sufferings, and Zhao Xiuyuan was getting closer and closer. She was really afraid that the young lady would drive her crazy.
The master and the servant cried for a long time, and Wang Xilu's mood gradually calmed down. Then he looked at Banping and said with a choked voice: "Banping, you have been following me since you were a child. You know me best. In fact, I decided to break up my relationship and run away. It’s not that I don’t love him, but I’m afraid that I will be like my mother, who is obviously the first wife, but has to live in such a humble and humiliating way. I don’t want to live that kind of life. I would rather live with my love for him than with a man who doesn’t love me.”
"This slave knows... the pain in the young lady's heart. This slave knows best." Bansing said with tears in her eyes. If she didn't know how much pain her master felt in her heart, how could she hate Chu Jingnan so much?
"If he really dies, Bao'er will really be a fatherless child from now on. What should I tell Bao'er?"
When she left to get pregnant and have a son, she actually didn't decide not to let the father and son recognize each other. It's just that Bao'er was still young and needed her care, so she kept the Chu family from knowing about his existence to avoid mother and son being separated. But when he got older, she would eventually let him recognize his ancestor.
I thought that the father and son would meet one day, but now if Chu Jingnan is really dead, the father and son will never see each other again. I am afraid that even if they meet under Jiuquan in the future, they will not be able to know each other.
When he thought of this, Wang Xilu felt that he was sorry for Chu Jingnan, and his heart became even more uneasy.
"Miss, no, the general will be fine. Didn't you always say that the general is wise and brave? How can such a smart person do something uncertain? The general will definitely come back."
"Is that so?" Listening to the confident words half a screen away, Wang Xilu was like a drowning man trying to catch a piece of driftwood, seriously wanting to believe it.
"Of course I have to come back, but can you first explain to me who Bao'er is?"
The sound that came out of nowhere made Wang Xilu look up in shock, but she didn't see a single figure, but the sound just now was so familiar that it made her panic and surprised her.
Is it him? Could it be him?
"Who is it?" Wang Xilu asked in a low voice, out of breath, with a hint of hope in his misty eyes.
When she finally saw the longing figure emerge from the small study room separated from the big tent.
Although he was not as arrogant and unrestrained as usual at this moment, and looked like a slovenly veteran, Wang Xilu recognized him at a glance. She raised her hand to cover her lips, but never made a sound, for fear of causing trouble for him.
He's not dead, really not dead!
"Should you first explain who Bao'er is?"
Chu Jingnan shouldn't have seen her at this time, because tonight was the most important key to his entire plan. The reason why he disguised himself and sneaked into the camp was just to come to his grandfather to discuss the plan for the evening. He should cooperate inside and outside and capture all the spies in the camp in one fell swoop.
But after discussing the matter, he couldn't help but want to take a look at her quietly, but he didn't expect that when he heard her crying, he couldn't even move forward.
It wasn't until she mentioned Bao'er's name to Banping and the series of conversations that he finally couldn't help but speak out. In addition to being filled with heartache, there was also uncontrollable distress in his heart.
"You..." Without answering his question, Wang Xilu stood up suddenly. Her vision suddenly went dark and her head felt dizzy, but she still stumbled towards him.
She had to make sure he was real and not a phantom she had imagined in her grief.
But after she had only taken two steps, her body lost strength and she was about to fall to the ground. Fortunately, Chu Jingnan had quick eyesight and stepped forward to support her, and took her into his arms.
But Banping, who had just rushed forward to support her master, paused, then turned around and walked out without hesitation. She wanted to guard this rare space for them.
When his warmth penetrated into her body through her fair skin, all Wang Xilu's fear, sadness, and previous resentment towards him disappeared.
It turns out that as long as he lives... everything will be fine, and nothing else will matter.
For the first time, she took the initiative to hug his waist, stood on tiptoes, raised her head, kissed his lips passionately, and lingered.
Chu Jingnan was immediately excited, and his steely heart suddenly softened.
Has she forgiven him? How could she be so kind...to forgive him like this? He was already prepared to spend his whole life atonement from her.
Chapter 9(2)
After a kiss, Chu Jingnan couldn't help but curl up his slightly pursed lips when he saw Wang Xilu's breathless look. If he wasn't afraid that she would faint again, how could he be willing to let her go?
"Who is Bao'er?" In order to avoid being unable to control himself and knocking her down at an inappropriate time and eating her, he had no choice but to ask again to distract his attention.
"Bao'er, Bao'er is..." With a blushing face, Wang Xilu's words reached his lips, but he stopped.
When she left the Chu family, she didn't even know she was pregnant. Now that she suddenly said that Bao'er was his son, would he believe it?
Not missing the flash of fear and hesitation in her eyes, Chu Jingnan knew that she still didn't dare to trust him completely. He felt sad in his heart, but he didn't say anything more. "Just say it if you don't want to. Let's talk when you want to."
He hugged her gently, not wanting to leave her embarrassed and hesitant. For her, he put down his body as a man and turned into a pool of spring water, wrapping her warmly from head to toe.
She suddenly raised her head, looked seriously at the smile on his face, and naturally saw the sadness hidden in his eyes. She played with a buckle on her chest, and then whispered: "Bao'er is your son. He is over a year old this year. He is so cute and clinging..."
In order to cover up her nervousness, Wang Xilu kept talking for a long time, but Chu Jingnan didn't react at all, so she couldn't help but raise her head and glance at him again. It was okay not to look, but when she looked at him, she saw his stunned look of shock.
Was he scared out of his wits? Or does he not believe that Bao'er is his son?
Just when Wang Xilu was thinking wildly, Chu Jingnan suddenly lowered his head and growled in her ear: "You damn woman, if the current situation didn't allow it, I would definitely beat your ass, you..."
Sure enough, when he heard her say it from her own mouth, he couldn't help but be angry...
It turned out that he believed it and was just angry.
The corners of Wang Xilu's lips slightly raised again, and then he stood up on tiptoes very wisely, applying his red lips, just to calm down the furious Chu Jingnan.
There were no more secrets or barriers between the two of them, and the kiss went from being a little rough at the beginning, like a vent, to tenderness. Chu Jingnan's hand even opened the button on Wang Xilu's lapel.
One, two, three...
"Hey, it's almost dark, are you coming out?"
I knew that this guy must have taken advantage of the green girl, otherwise why would he have been looking at her for an hour? Although Jiang Chengyu also wanted to be magnanimous and give Chu Jingnan more time, he couldn't delay the business, so he could only barge in amid the disapproving eyes on half the screen and be the bad guy who beat the mandarin ducks.
Hearing his voice, Wang Xilu seemed to be frightened. He was so embarrassed that he struggled to get out of Chu Jingnan's arms, but Chu Jingnan ignored him and hugged Wang Xilu openly. Then he looked at Jiang Chengyu provocatively and said dissatisfiedly: "You really have no eyesight. Don't you know what you are doing is immoral?"
Hearing this accusation, Jiang Chengyu was on the verge of tears. It was obvious that this general was neglecting his duties and was greedy for the warm fragrance of soft jade. He reminded him kindly, but he turned out to be an inhumane person inside and outside.
"Don't talk like that, cousin. We have business to do. I'll wait for you to come back and find your son together." With a seductive blush on his face, Wang Xilu stretched out his hand to straighten Chu Jingnan's clothes, and then pushed Chu Jingnan to tell him not to miss the business.
"Wait for me. After this is over, let's go pick up our son together!" Chu Zhennan kissed her cheek cheekily and made a promise.
"There's a fire! There's a fire——"
Because of his words of "wait for me", Wang Xilu waited for him calmly. Who would have thought that after waiting, he would wait for the noisy shouting outside.
